prompt:
Create ONE isolated fantasy game inventory item sprite, named "마족의 장창". First reference is ONLY source of monster-specific object design, materials and palette. Second and third references are existing INVENTORY PIXEL ART STYLE examples: match those coarse square pixel clusters and simple stepped dark outlines, broad readable color planes. Do not draw the monster. Demon long spear. Copy back-mounted spear from weapon master: large silver angular leaf head with gray center ridge, short brass socket, tiny deep-red cloth tucked close below head, long straight brown wooden shaft, small gold ferrule at bottom. Upright point up, narrow long silhouette.
LAYOUT: 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Item occupies 3 vertical SQUARE inventory cells in a single column. Keep entire object within central vertical strip width 512 pixels (x=256..768), with 5% padding INSIDE strip. Outside strip fully transparent. Object extends y65..1470; width nowhere exceeds 466.6666666666667px. Critical true item aspect ratio 1:3, not a broad 2:3 object.
STYLE: deliberately low-resolution pixel art, approximately 32 logical square pixels per inventory cell, uniformly enlarged crisp blocks. 3-5 discrete shades per material, dark charcoal-purple outline, pale highlight upper left, no fine microtexture, no smooth gradients, no antialias blur, no photorealism. Preserve large iconic shapes legible at 48px per cell. Transparent RGBA background, alpha zero outside item. No vignette, no glow haze, no shadow under item, no frame, no grid lines, no text, no watermark, no extra unrelated objects. Full intact silhouette with safe margins. Any magic must be solid sharply stepped pixels confined to occupied cells.
